INT_GROUND_MIN_ENERGY.why: ground_hit value is negative so min_energy never true

INT_HITSIDE_NOBULLET.why: hit_side left/right/top/bottom false without a bullet in the command

INT_DELAYEX_LOST.why: delay_ex drops instigator and bone: effector, hit_side left/right lost

INT_DELAY_CTX_LOST.why: delay and delay_effect run a fresh command without volume or part

INT_HEALTH_NO_DIE.why: health damage never kills; no die reachable from the handler

WARN_TAG_ADD_BLOCK.why: run-time tags add cannot switch an interaction block on

WARN_FIRE_PLACE.why: fire place name unknown so the owner's fires table never matches
